title: How to use AI Blocks workflows from start to finish
seoTitle: How to use AI Blocks workflows, step by step
description: Run an AI Blocks workflow from start to finish: read the page, download it, run each step with approval stops, check the result, and build your own.
lede: A workflow splits one bigger job into steps, each run by its own skill, with checks and pauses in between. This guide shows how to read a workflow page, run one step by step in your own AI, check the result with a fresh pair of eyes, and build your own.
